entries.01936bdeec28ffbf: A comprehensive disaster prevention company in the Secom group that handles fire alarm systems and fire extinguishing systems end to end, from manufacture, sale and installation to maintenance and inspection.
entries.0b3ed472a53ba2e6: Fire Doors and Smoke Control Equipment
entries.17190e90a00c8c48: This business manufactures and sells, and performs installation work for, automatic fire alarm equipment, environmental monitoring systems, fire doors, smoke control equipment and other products. The company and Shanghai Nōmi Shōbō Setsubi Yūgen Kōsha manufacture and sell the products, and group companies in each region handle sales and construction. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥51,017 million, making this the largest business in the group.
entries.24ec38775de45bb3: This system monitors the environmental conditions of buildings and other structures. There is no separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.33b3b87ed3cfe15d: This equipment detects the heat of a fire and automatically sprays water. There is no separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.38c9e9f4749a81a2: This business manufactures and sells, and performs installation work for, various sprinkler equipment, foam fire extinguishing equipment, plant disaster prevention equipment, tunnel disaster prevention equipment and other products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥46,873 million.
entries.6196aed0c770c34a: Plant and Tunnel Disaster Prevention Equipment
entries.6aa5f1de99583dec: These are fire doors and smoke control equipment that limit the spread of smoke in a fire. There is no separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.7f21a07330a56076: This business is not included in the reportable segments. It constructs and maintains parking lot traffic control systems and, through Meisei Electric, manufactures and sells weather disaster prevention and space defense equipment, among other activities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,032 million.
entries.87fe9fd3de91fa7a: This equipment detects fires early and gives notice of them. There is no separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.bcdc3a577ea23b8b: This is disaster prevention equipment for plants at factories and other sites, and for tunnels. There is no separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.f18c27722f142d23: This business performs maintenance, inspection and repair work on various disaster prevention equipment. Besides the company, group companies such as Kyushu Nohmi and Nohmi System handle this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥36,734 million.
